current_bottleneck: The previously accepted integrated path protected each participant capability with one settlement-wide X25519 private key, so compromise or misuse of that key could reveal any submitted order before matching.
causal_hypothesis: A fresh symmetric key per order, Shamir-shared 3-of-7 with participant signatures and Feldman verification, can remove the pre-match single-key failure while preserving automatic Maker reservation, Taker DvP, and the observed MPC result.
single_intended_change: Replace the settlement-wide capability-decryption key with node-local encrypted one-order key shares and release them only after each node has durably recorded the exact authorized MPC result.

baseline.remaining_risk: One laboratory settlement private key could open either participant capability before matching.

most_likely_prediction_error: Serializing a fixed-size key-share response and contacting all seven nodes adds little cryptographic work, but shared-host MP-SPDZ and Avalanche startup variance may move elapsed time materially around 60000 ms.
rejection_rules: a settlement-wide capability private key is generated or loaded
two or fewer node shares open an order capability
a key share can be released before the exact completed matching receipt is durable
a non-settlement mutual-TLS role can request a key share
an unmatched IOC order can release its capability
either matching round returns fewer than seven valid agreeing receipts
the settlement capability or reconstructed key fails commitment and VSS binding
Maker reservation is not finalized before the Taker round
trade price is not 100 or quantity is not 40
Taker reservation and DvP do not finalize atomically
the same canonical transition is accepted twice
any validator returns a different root before or after restart
the artifact contains private order material or capability-key shares
the artifact claims a production property excluded by the contract
promotion_rules: every functional rejection rule remains false
unit and mutual-TLS tests prove the two-share, pre-result, unmatched-IOC, wrong-role, wrong-output and tamper rejection boundaries
the integrated artifact records the exact contract SHA-256 and manifest identifier
the integrated artifact records seven MPC receipts per round, at least three valid releases per opened order, and five agreeing validator roots
the integrated artifact preserves every contract non-claim
the observed elapsed time is reported only as one-host functional evidence
